> Found Everywhere is a UK-based SEO and AI visibility agency. We help businesses
> appear in Google search, the map pack, and AI answer engines including ChatGPT,
> Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot. We offer a free AI and search visibility
> report, and all our work is delivered as an ongoing monthly engagement.

## Services
- [SEO Audit](https://foundeverywhere.co.uk/services/seo-audit): Technical and on-page SEO audit.
- [LLM Visibility](https://foundeverywhere.co.uk/services/llm-visibility): Being cited and recommended inside AI answer engines.
- [Technical SEO](https://foundeverywhere.co.uk/services/technical-seo): Site architecture, Core Web Vitals, schema, and indexation.
- [Ongoing SEO & Visibility](https://foundeverywhere.co.uk/services/ongoing-seo-and-visibility): Monthly retainer covering SEO and AI visibility management.
- [Local SEO & Google Business](https://foundeverywhere.co.uk/services/local-seo): Local search, map pack, and Google Business Profile optimisation.
- [Expert Content](https://foundeverywhere.co.uk/services/expert-content): Content strategy and production for search and AI citation.
- [Web Design](https://foundeverywhere.co.uk/services/web-design): Fast, modern websites built for search and AI visibility.
- [Paid Search & Social](https://foundeverywhere.co.uk/services/paid-search-and-social): Google Ads, Meta, and LinkedIn campaign management.
